an5.71:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] pañcime bhikkhave dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā cetovimuttiphalā ca honti cetovimuttiphalānisaṃsā ca. paññāvimuttiphalā ca honti paññāvimuttiphalānisaṃsā ca.
an5.71:2.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu asubhānupassī kāye viharati, āhāre paṭikkūlasaññī, sabbaloke anabhiratasaññī, sabbasaṅkhāresu aniccānupassī, maraṇasaññā kho panassa ajjhattaṃ sūpaṭṭhitā hoti.
an5.71:2.3: ime kho bhikkhave pañca dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā cetovimuttiphalā ca honti, cetovimuttiphalānisāṃsā ca. paññāvimuttiphalā ca honti paññāvimuttiphalānisaṃsā ca.
an5.71:2.4: yato kho bhikkhave cetovimutto ca hoti paññāvimutto ca,
an5.71:2.5: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhū ukkhittapaligho itipi saṅkiṇṇaparikho itipi abbūḷhesiko itipi niraggaḷo itipi ariyo pannaddhajo pannabhāro visaṃyutto itipi.
an5.71:3.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno avijjā pahīnā hoti ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
an5.71:3.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ukkhittapaligho hoti.
an5.71:4.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno ponobhaviko jātisaṃsāro pahīno hoti …pe…
an5.71:4.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu saṅkiṇṇaparikho hoti.
an5.71:5.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno taṇhā pahīnā hoti ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
an5.71:5.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu abbūḷhesiko hoti.
an5.71:6.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno pañcorambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni pahīnāni honti ucchinnamūlāni tālāvatthukatāni anabhāvakatāni, āyatiṃ anuppādadhammāni.
an5.71:6.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu niraggaḷo hoti.
an5.71:7.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyo pannaddhajo pannabhāro visaṃyutto hoti?
an5.71:7.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno asmimāno pahīno hoti ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvakato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo.
an5.71:7.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyo pannaddhajo pannabhāro visaṃyutto hotī’ti.
